claims.text: Hallucinations across the LLM lifecycle can be categorized into three stages: data-related, training-related, and inference-related.

evidence.description: The authors propose a threefold categorization of hallucinations across the LLM lifecycle: data-related, training-related, and inference-related, aligned with LLM development.

methodologies.name: Lifecycle-based survey and taxonomy framework
methodologies.description: A systematic survey framework categorizing causes, detection, mitigation, and prevention of LLM hallucinations across data-related, training-related, and inference-related development stages.

limitations.text: Previous surveys on LLM hallucinations have primarily focused isolatedly on detection or mitigation rather than taking a comprehensive lifecycle perspective.
